establishment_basis: The current user task explicitly authorizes establishing a minimal founding governance mechanism; it does not identify or sign for a human maintainer.
authoring_authority: Repository contributors under scoped task authorization
review_authority: Recorded repository reviewers; every included ID and exact record checksum requires a decision
rc_authority: Founding maintainer accepts exact source commit, scope and contracts, then explicitly authorizes RC issuance
adoption_authority: Founding maintainer by a separate final-adoption decision after RC validation
publication_authority: Maintainer or explicitly delegated release operator, bound to adopted bytes
multi_party_migration: Version the governance policy and record transfer of roles/procedure prospectively; retain all historical pins, decisions and requirement meanings.
